adorablehamsterpets.items.retrievableIte: Items the hamster views as gifts or toys to bring back to you. Picking these up triggers Delivery Mode. Default: Hard Acorns.
adorablehamsterpets.main.accessorySss.de: Subsurface Scattering, i.e, the amount of light that passes through accessories like Pink Petals and Hard Acorn Hats. 65 is solid, 255 is pure translucent gelatin.
adorablehamsterpets.main.acornDropChance: The likelihood (0.0 to 1.0) of a hard acorn dropping each time your hamster rummages. Default is very low at 0.03 (3%), because the hamster rummages roughly ~5 times per second. Crank it up if you want to crash the local squirrel economy. (Maximum output is 1 acorn per second even if you turn it all the way up).
adorablehamsterpets.main.heistableLeaves: A list of block IDs or tags that are considered valid leaves for the Tree Heist. Defaults to vanilla Oak Leaves and Dynamic Trees' Oak Leaves. Note: The Dynamic Trees mod adds their own type of acorns and drop methods. When that mod is installed, the only way to get the specific hard acorns from my mod is through the Tree Heist.
adorablehamsterpets.main.itemStealing.de: For when your hamster develops a taste for the finer things in life. Can be configured so they steal or fetch any item— even from other mods. They steal diamonds and fetch hard acorns by default.
Determines whether you are able to see the jaunty little Hard Acorn Hat when hamsters are wearing the base Hard Acorn Armor. Does not affect what other players see, and does not apply to the standalone Acorn Hat accessory.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.oakLeavesAc: Chance (0.0 to 1.0) for an Oak Leaf block to drop a Hard Acorn when broken. Default is low, similar to Apples.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.standardArm: Chance (0.0 to 1.0) to find Hard Acorn, Iron, or Gold hamster armor in standard Dungeons, Temples, Mineshafts, etc.
advancements.adorablehamsterpets.husband: Cast responsibility to the wind by over-harvesting a tree until it stops giving hard acorns.
Obtain a Hard Acorn. Represents the absolute pinnacle of hamster foraging technology.
Equip the Hard Acorn Hat. Your hamsters cuteness has increased from infinity to... infinity squared.
book.adorablehamsterpets.category.access: Your hamster lacks a crippling sense of vanity. Let's fix that.$(br2)This section details the latest in rodent runway fashion, from $(l:accessories/flowers)<dark_green><b>flowers</> to $(l:accessories/acorn_hat)<dark_green><b>hard acorn hats</>.$(br2)You can even $(l:accessories/custom_accessories)<dark_green><b>suggest your own!</>
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.acorn_hat: Shove the <dark_green><b>Hard Acorn Hat</> into the $(l:advanced_rodentry/cheek_pouches#equipment_slots)<dark_green><b>Bling</> slot to grant the Arboreal Affinity perk: double $(l:advanced_rodentry/tree_heist_and_armor#intro)<dark_green><b>Tree Heist</> yields.$(br2)Perhaps looking like a nut helps them infiltrate the canopy unnoticed. Or maybe they just work harder when they feel pretty.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.how_acces: $(br)There is also a separate '$(l:advanced_rodentry/cheek_pouches#equipment_slots)<dark_green><b>Armor</>' slot. It functions exactly how you'd expect.$(br2)Pro-tip: The base Hard Acorn Armor <i>also</> includes the hat for aesthetics, but if you want to get the Arboreal Affinity perk, you must equip the separate $(l:accessories/acorn_hat)<dark_green><b>Hard Acorn Hat</> accessory in the Bling slot.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.tree_heis: To obtain hamster armor, start by $(l:shoulder_hamsters/the_hamster_yeet)<dark_green><b>throwing</> your hamster at some Oak Leaves (or dismount near them) to initiate a <dark_green><b>Tree Heist</>.$(br2)They will vanish into the canopy, rustle around, and occasionally toss out <dark_green><b>Hard Acorns</> until the tree is depleted.

Think nature is too stingy? I added a slider in the $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>Config</> just for you.$(br2)Crank up the 'Hard Acorn Drop Chance' if you want it to rain nuts (limit: 1 per second).$(br2)Just don't blame me when your inventory overflows.

The <dark_green><b>Hard Acorns</>? Useless on their own, unless you enjoy composting and choking hazards.$(br2)Process them in a <b>Stonecutter</> to create $(l:advanced_rodentry/tree_heist_and_armor#acorn_armor)<dark_green><b>Hard Acorn Shards</>, used for $(l:advanced_rodentry/tree_heist_and_armor#acorn_armor)<dark_green><b>Armor</> or the stylish $(l:accessories/acorn_hat)<dark_green><b>Hard Acorn Hat</>.
Combine the shards with the hat to create <dark_green><b>Hard Acorn Armor</>.$(br2)Completely blocks incoming attack damage until it runs out of durability.
message.adorablehamsterpets.tree_heist_s: Your hamster searches the same tree repeatedly. It will soon be depleted of hard acorns.
